Scholarship / Fee Waivers
DSU Fee Waivers / Scholarships Options
Sibling Fee Waiver:
20% on Tuition Fee
DHA/DSU Employee:
50% on Tuition Fee
For DHACSS students:
10% Scholarship on Tuition Fee.
100% Admission Fee waiver (Rs 15,000/-)
Scholarships for DHA City Campus Programs :
25% fee waiver on Tuition Fee for all programs offered at the DSU DCK Campus, i.e., B.E. Civil Engineering, Bachelor of
Architecture, BS Computer Science, and BS Artificial Intelligence.
Merit-Based Scholarships
Students securing first/second/third position in the Intermediate Board Examinations are eligible for 90% Merit Scholarship
throughout the degree program.
Academically outstanding students (first 5% of intake) are given Merit Scholarships of varying amount starting from second
semester onwards, based on the results of the preceding semester as per rules.
Need-Based Scholarships
Need-based scholarships upto 90% in Tuition Fee for needy and financially constrained students are available
Special Scholarships in Master and PhD Programs
20% waiver in Tuition Fee for a Master or PhD student, if he/she has 3.5 or more CGPA in semester system or 80% marks or more
in annual examination in the last degree from HEC recognized university.
50% Tuition Fee waiver for DHA employees and their wards in Master and PhD programs
Admissions Fee waiver for DSU Alumni and 25% waiver in Tuition Fee for taking admission in any of the DSU’s Master and PhD

- “How can I apply?” → Admissions Process + Admissions Info; mark COVID-era offline wording stale.
- “What are admission requirements?” → FAQs + Admission Regulations + the individual program page.
- “Can I transfer credits?” → Admission Regulations, not generic FAQs alone.
- “What is the processing fee?” → Spring 2027 notice if that session is specified; otherwise surface discrepancy and request confirmation.
- “Is there hostel accommodation?” → DCK hostel facilities; do not promise a vacancy.
- “What is DSU’s opening time?” → **Unknown from corpus**; do not guess.
